name: frugal
description: Cost-free mode for Claude Code. Helper subagents (Explore and friends) run on Haiku, and a summarize_free tool lets Claude hand big files and logs to a free Gemini model instead of reading them whole. /frugal on, off, status. Needs function hooks (early access).

geminiKey.title: Gemini API key
geminiKey.description: A free key from aistudio.google.com. Empty means the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

geminiModels.title: Gemini models, in order
geminiModels.description: Comma-separated. When one is busy or out of quota, the next is tried.

helperModel.title: Model for helper agents
helperModel.description: Which model helper subagents run on when they do not ask for one.

helperTypes.title: Helper agent types
helperTypes.description: Comma-separated subagent types that get the helper model when they don't ask for one.
